segments.title: December
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! December is Wrapped. The year is ending, everyone is reflecting, and every member has a story told in classes, favourite trainers and peak hours. This month we show them that story, and help them write next year's.

segments.title: ₹1.7L
segments.text: So, the number. Our December target for Pop-up is 1.7 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent more than last December. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 81,500 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 74,600, comebacks 11,800, and everything else 1,700. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 45 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 527 leads, 137 trials, and 45 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 76,300 rupees, which is 45 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Secret Santa Squats
segments.text: First up, for gifting, Secret Santa Squats. Two classes and grip socks, sized for a Secret Santa budget. If the recipient loves it, half comes off their first month. The plan is 4 buyers at about 1,000, so 4,000 rupees.

segments.title: Last Seen: 2026 (We Noticed)
segments.text: Next, for long-lapsed members, Last Seen, 2026. We noticed. Fifteen per cent off, a free comeback class, and a spot on the Stronger in 30 comeback track, before the new year. The plan is 2 buyers at about 7,200, so 14,500 rupees.

segments.title: Wrapped: Your Top Artist Was Your Trainer
segments.text: Then, Wrapped. Your top artist was your trainer. Every member gets their year in classes, trainers and peak hours, and next year's plan, priced for how they actually train. The plan is 4 buyers at about 7,200, so 28,900 rupees.

segments.title: 12 Days of Shakemas
segments.text: And finally, the finale, Twelve Days of Shakemas. A new published deal every day from the thirteenth to the twenty-fourth. No hidden prizes, no tricks. Day twelve is the big one. The plan is 4 buyers at about 7,200, so 28,900 rupees.
segments.notes: One deal per person per day

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Wrapped cards go out to every member. Week two, twelve days of Shakemas begin on the thirteenth. Week three, gift vouchers and resolution pre-orders for the I'll start in January crowd. Week four, last-seen members get their invitation home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's December at Pop-up. 1.7 lakh rupees, four offers, and 45 buyers to welcome. That's a wrap on 2027. See you on the mat in January.
